raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

FlashAttention 3 is the common attention implementation used by several SGLang model families. The MUSA backend needs the same metadata lifecycle and forward coverage as the parent backend so that models using GQA, MLA, sliding-window attention, encoder/cross attention, embedding, speculative decoding, and context-parallel full attention can share one attention implementation on Moore Threads devices. This change ports the backend behavior while keeping the common attention stack unchanged.

## Supported attention paths

| Attention path | Coverage | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Causal full attention | Supported | GQA/MQA layouts and paged KV cache |
| MLA | Supported | Wrapper-generated scheduler metadata and absorbed MLA layout |
| Sliding-window attention | Supported | Separate window metadata and SWA KV write locations |
| Cross/encoder attention | Supported in backend/tests | Encoder scheduler metadata and translated KV locations |
| Bidirectional / encoder-only | Supported | Non-causal and symmetric window handling |
| Embedding / skip-KV | Supported | No KV-pool writes; eager path validated |
| Speculative decoding | Supported | Multi-step metadata and graph paths |
| Context-parallel full attention | Supported | Reuses the parent CP strategy for KV materialization and attention dispatch |
| Context-parallel MLA | Implemented and runtime-validated on DeepSeek-V2-Lite | MLA uses per-side wrapper metadata; 128K TP8/CP2 passed with radix cache on/off |
| Context-parallel SWA/local | Implemented and runtime-validated on MiMo-V2.5 | TP8/CP2, 128000-token requests passed with Radix cache enabled and disabled |

## Modifications

- Add the MUSA FA3 metadata and forward paths for the supported attention paths above, including eager execution and graph capture/replay.
- Reuse the parent CP strategy for dense full-attention KV materialization and the two-side CP attention dispatch instead of the deprecated platform shim.
- Keep public backend signatures, annotations, and parent-compatible naming aligned with the upstream FA3 backend.
- Generate scheduler metadata through the installed `flash_attn_interface` wrapper; no direct package-level MATE dependency is added to the backend.
- Preserve parent behavior for physical KV-location translation, cross-attention metadata, SWA writes, skip-KV, bidirectional attention, scales, and multi-step speculative state.
- Keep the existing platform prefill-CP validation unchanged; attention CP is selected separately through `attn_cp_size` and the parent strategy.
- Add registered CPU metadata tests covering interface parity, metadata conversion, MLA, cross attention, SWA locations, skip-KV/bidirectional behavior, multi-step state, split policy, and metadata forwarding.

## Validation

| Test | Configuration | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Registered unit tests | CPU mock metadata suite, 15 tests | 15/15 passed in the target 5.2 image |
| Static checks | isort, Ruff, format, compileall, diff check | Changed-file checks passed; upstream fix #47078 has landed and the branch is rebased on it |
| GQA backend lifecycle | 131072-token paged KV, eager + graph | Passed; finite output and changing replay |
| MLA backend lifecycle | 131072-token paged KV, wrapper metadata, eager + graph | Passed; output shape 1x16x512 |
| SWA backend lifecycle | 131072-token paged KV, window 1024, eager + graph | Passed |
| Qwen2.5-7B GQA | 128K input, graph and eager | HTTP 200 with four output tokens |
| Radix cache | Same 128K request, cache on/off | 127936 cached tokens with cache on; zero with cache off |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite MLA | 128K eager request | HTTP 200 with four output tokens |
| MiMo-V2.5 SWA | TP8/CP2, window 128, 128000-token eager request | PASS: HTTP 200 with one-token completion, Radix off and on; repeated cache-on request reported 127936 cached tokens |
| Qwen3-VL + Eagle3 | 128K speculative request | Target/draft graph paths passed |
| Embedding / skip-KV | Qwen2.5-7B, 128K encode request | Finite 3584-dimensional embedding |
| GSM8K multi-round | 20 questions, 3 rounds, Radix on/off | 71.67% vs 70.00%; no systematic cache regression |
| Context-parallel GQA | TP2, CP2, Qwen3-4B, 128000-token input | Passed in the 5.2 runtime on the BF16 path; HTTP 200, four-token completion, 48.0s end-to-end latency; 127936 cached tokens on the repeated request |
| Context-parallel MLA | Parent-aligned implementation and metadata paths | PASS: DeepSeek-V2-Lite TP8/CP2, 128002 prompt tokens; cache on/off both returned HTTP 200, and cache-on repeat reported cached-token 128000 (5.2.0 image) |
| Context-parallel SWA/local | MiMo-V2.5 FP8, TP8/CP2, window 128, 128000-token eager request | PASS: cache-off and cache-on requests returned HTTP 200; repeated cache-on request reported 127936 cached tokens |

No performance claim is made. The CP implementation follows the parent strategy for full, MLA, SWA, and local attention metadata paths. Runtime evidence covers dense GQA, MLA, and SWA/local attention.

## Checklist

- [x] Common attention components unchanged.
- [x] Changed-file community formatting and lint checks.
- [x] Rebased after upstream fix #47078 resolved the unrelated full-repository lint failure.
- [x] Registered CPU tests.
- [x] Real long-context MUSA validation for GQA, MLA, SWA, eager, graph, embedding, speculative decoding, and cache on/off.
- [x] CP implementation follows the parent strategy for full attention and the corresponding MLA/SWA/local metadata paths.
- [x] Dense CP implementation removes the deprecated shim call.
- [x] Full 2-rank CP acceptance on the 5.2 runtime (Qwen3 GQA, TP2/CP2, 128K input).
- [x] Model-level 128K CP MLA request with radix cache enabled and disabled (DeepSeek-V2-Lite, TP8/CP2).
- [x] Model-specific 128K CP request for SWA/local attention (MiMo-V2.5 FP8, TP8/CP2, Radix cache enabled and disabled).

Thanks for the detailed validation matrix — the engineering here is real and in the right place: it inherits `FlashAttentionBackend`, reuses the parent CP strategy, keeps the code under `hardware_backend/musa/`, and the long comment block at `:468-498` is the most useful thing I read in this diff. I reviewed against the parent (`layers/attention/flashattention_backend.py`) and against the review history for this subsystem. The blocking items are all about **silent staleness** and **silent wrong-side selection** in the graph-replay and CP paths, plus one unvalidated MLA prefill argument mismatch — which is also where this file has already shipped a CP correctness fix (#23270). ### How the change runs ```mermaid flowchart TD A["init_forward_metadata()"] --> A1["super() + _ensure_metadata_types()
parent metadata → Musa* subclasses"] A1 --> A3{"input_ids empty?
(empty DP rank)"} A3 -->|yes| A4["return early, no metadata"] A3 -->|no| B["_init_scheduler_metadata()"] B --> B1{"use_mla?"} B1 -->|yes| B2["_init_mla_scheduler_metadata()"] B1 -->|no| B3["_init_no_mla_scheduler_metadata()"] B2 --> C["_init_cp_scheduler_metadata()"] B3 --> C C --> C1["_cp_side_lengths(): 3× .item() sync"] C2 --> D["_build_scheduler_metadata() → get_scheduler_metadata()"] C --> C2["_init_cp_self / _local / _side"] G["init_forward_metadata_out_graph(in_capture)"] --> G2{"in_capture?"} G2 -->|yes| G3["capture: build + record slots"] G2 -->|no| G4["replay: rebuild + copy into captured tensors"] F["forward_extend / forward_decode"] --> F1["_scheduler_metadata_for_kvcache()
full / swa / encoder / local"] F --> F2["_cp_scheduler_metadata_for_kvcache()
side from tensor identity"] F1 --> H["flash_attn_with_kvcache(scheduler_metadata=…, num_splits=…)"] F2 --> H classDef added fill:#e8f5e9,stroke:#2e7d32,stroke-width:2px class A1,B,B2,B3,C,C1,C2,D,G3,G4,F1,F2 added ``` Green = added by this PR. ### Prior art for this subsystem Corpus sweep: **32,639 threads scanned, 405 matched across 142 PRs, 681 human comments** (`hardware_backend/`, `layers/attention/`; terms: cuda graph, scheduler metadata, num_splits, split-kv, context parallel, cross attention, musa). Four opinions bear on this diff: 1. When the MUSA backend moved to inheritance, the ask was to **drop the platform shim** ("I don't know if `FlashAttentionContext` … are still necessary here. Because this time, we choose to inherit from `FlashAttentionBackend`" — #22051). This PR inherits, but then disables a parent hook and rebuilds the lifecycle beside it. 2. **No `seq_lens.max().item()` in the hot path** ("We should avoid CPU-GPU synchronization … Can you derive this value from `seq_lens_cpu`?" — #4514). 3. MUSA-specific code belongs under `hardware_backend/musa/` and aligned with the existing call site (#23270) — honored here. 4. This file already shipped one CP correctness fix ("Resolve output garbage in Context Parallel on MusaFlashAttentionBackend", #23270), so CP paths need correctness evidence, not smoke. ### Additional findings (beyond the inline comments) **P1** - **CP decode synchronizes the device 3× per side, per step.** `_cp_side_lengths()` does `int(q_lens.sum().item())`, `int(k_lens.max().item())`, `int(q_lens.max().item())` (`:820-823`) inside `init_forward_metadata`, i.e. right before every graph replay. Derive `max_seqlen_q`/`max_seqlen_k` from the CP metadata's CPU-side lengths; this is the pattern maintainers have pushed back on before (see corpus item 2). **P2** - **The parent hook is disabled rather than generalized.** `self._get_scheduler_metadata = None` (`:262`) exists because the parent callback uses the FA3 signature (`num_heads`) while MATE needs `num_heads_q` / `num_heads_kv`. A small signature widening in the parent would let both backends share the hook. - **Non-uniform attention layouts become a startup crash.** `_get_no_mla_layer_attention_layouts()` raises `ValueError` when full-attention layers disagree on layout (`:360-374`). A model that the CUDA backend serves becomes unusable on MUSA. Falling back to per-call metadata keeps coverage; if you keep the raise, name the model and the divergent layers in the message. - **The empty-DP-rank early return rests on an unverified claim** (`:1364-1373`). If the attention forward is not actually a shape-preserving no-op, the wrapper's `assert scheduler_metadata is not None` (`:154`) fires. A pointer to the code that guarantees the no-op would make this reviewable. - **`_gather_paged_kv_for_varlen()` materializes the entire prefix KV** (Python loop + `torch.cat`, `:1479-1509`). It is only reachable from the `deterministic_cached_prefix` branch (`:1815`), so it is acceptable — but it is O(prefix) device memory and its `assert seq_lens is not None` (`:1486`) would fire under capture, because `_seq_lens_cpu_list()` returns `None` in capture mode (`:299-300`). A comment stating "eager-only, deterministic path only" would prevent a future caller from wiring it into a graph. **P3** - `assert` used for user-facing preconditions in the wrapper (`:154`) and in the hot path (`:1456`). Prefer `ValueError` / `RuntimeError`. - `seq_lens_sum` and `seq_lens_cpu` are accepted and never used by `_prepare_graph_replay_scheduler_metadata()` (`:1346-1359`). - `_max_seqlen_from_metadata()` still reaches `cache_seqlens.max().item()` on the eager path (`:748`) whenever `max_seq_len_k` is unset. ### CI All three "PR Test" checks are red on the **`run-ci` label gate**, not on code — run 40871271611, step *Require run-ci label (optional)*: `Missing required label 'run-ci'`. That means the new registered CPU suite has **never executed in CI**; please add the label so the 15 tests actually run before this is considered. ### Test gaps The 15 tests are mock-level metadata tests. Nothing covers the graph copy-back path, the CP side selection, `num_splits` agreement between `get_scheduler_metadata()` and the call site, or MLA prefill. Three tests assert the *absence* of methods (`test_removed_legacy_cuda_graph_metadata_hooks`, `test_musa_scheduler_helper_does_not_override_parent_hook`) rather than behavior, so they keep passing even if the replacement logic is wrong. A harness that fakes two captures and one replay and asserts the captured tensors actually changed would cover the riskiest ~60 lines in the PR in ~30 lines of test. ### Verdict Blocking: the inline items (graph-metadata refresh is silent on failure and guarded only by `assert`; the MLA `causal` mismatch; CP side inferred from tensor identity; the hand-maintained slot list; the Gemma4 split policy contradicting itself with no measurement) plus the CP per-step syncs. Requesting changes.

The boolean return of `_copy_fresh_metadata_to_graph_tensors()` is dropped here. When the key is absent — a `bs`/`spec_info` combination that was never captured — the helper returns `False` and this call becomes a no-op, so the graph replays with the metadata that was baked in at capture time. That is exactly the staleness this function exists to prevent, and it is completely silent.

Please raise (or at least log and skip the replay) when it returns `False`. Same applies to the three `assert`s inside the helper (`:711`, `:719`, `:724`): slot-set equality, shape equality and the self-copy guard are production invariants, but `python -O` deletes them and then `copy_` runs against a mismatched tensor.

-    def __init__(self, model_runner: ModelRunner, **kwargs):
-        super().__init__(model_runner, **kwargs)
-        self.num_hidden_layers = model_runner.model_config.num_hidden_layers
-        self.first_k_dense_replace = model_runner.model_config.first_k_dense_replace
-        self.full_attention_interval = model_runner.model_config.full_attention_interval

-        # State for current attention call (simplified from thread‑local context)
-        self._current_layer: Optional[RadixAttention] = None
-        self._current_prefix: str = ""
-        self._current_max_seqlen_k: int = 0
-        self._current_can_run_tbo: bool = False
-
-        # Disable default scheduler metadata for fa3
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        model_runner: ModelRunner,
+        skip_prefill: bool = False,
+        speculative_step_id=0,
+        topk=0,
+        speculative_num_steps=0,
+        fa_impl_ver=3,
+    ):
+        if fa_impl_ver != 3:
+            raise ValueError("MUSA flash attention backend only supports FA3.")
+
+        super().__init__(
+            model_runner,
+            skip_prefill=skip_prefill,
+            speculative_step_id=speculative_step_id,
+            topk=topk,
+            speculative_num_steps=speculative_num_steps,
+            fa_impl_ver=fa_impl_ver,
+        )
+        model_config = model_runner.model_config
+        hf_config = model_config.hf_config
+        model_type = hf_config.model_type
+        architectures = hf_config.architectures or []
+        self._is_gemma4: bool = model_type in GEMMA4_MODEL_TYPES
+        # Gemma4's short sliding-window attention is faster without split-KV,
+        # while full attention benefits from FA3's automatic split heuristic.

`causal=False` is hardcoded into the MLA metadata here and at `:561` and `:583`, but the MLA calls pass `causal=causal` (`:2039` CP, `:2075` non-CP). `causal` is an argument to `get_scheduler_metadata` (`:531`), so the metadata is specialized on it.

- If MATE uses the metadata's causal flag, MLA **prefill** builds a non-causal plan and runs it causally.
- If MATE ignores it when `scheduler_metadata` is supplied, the call-site argument is misleading and should be dropped or documented.

This is invisible to the current evidence: DeepSeek-V2-Lite 128K with four output tokens is decode-shaped, where `q_len == 1` makes causal and non-causal identical. Can you confirm the contract, and add a prefill accuracy check?

nodes.body: The CP side is inferred from tensor identity. A caller that passes an equal-but-not-identical tensor silently gets the `next`-side metadata — a wrong-side scheduler plan with no error anywhere. Please pass `side: str` explicitly from the two call sites (`:1776`, `:2043`); it is one parameter and the failure mode disappears.

+            has_local_attention=has_local_attention_layer,
+            has_cross_attention=has_cross_attention_layer,
+            has_sliding_window_local_attention=has_swa_local_attention_layer,
+        )
+
+    def _needs_no_mla_kvcache_scheduler_metadata(
+        self,
+        forward_batch: SchedulerMetadataBatch,
+        *,
+        is_cross_attention: bool = False,
+    ) -> bool:
+        forward_mode = forward_batch.forward_mode
+        extend_prefix_lens_cpu = getattr(forward_batch, "extend_prefix_lens_cpu", None)
+        extend_with_prefix = extend_prefix_lens_cpu is not None and any(
+            extend_prefix_lens_cpu
+        )
+        return is_cross_attention or (
+            forward_mode.is_decode_or_idle()
+            or forward_mode.is_target_verify()
+            or forward_mode.is_draft_extend_v2()
+            or (
+                forward_mode.is_extend_or_draft_extend_or_mixed(
+                    include_draft_extend_v2=True
+                )
+                and extend_with_prefix
+            )
+        )
+
+    def _num_splits_for_no_mla_full_kvcache(
+        self, forward_batch: SchedulerMetadataBatch
+    ) -> int:
+        """Keep MiniMax-M2 decode-like full-attention metadata/calls aligned."""
+        if not self._is_minimax_m2:
+            return self.full_attention_num_splits
+
+        batch_size = getattr(forward_batch, "batch_size", None)
+        if batch_size is None or batch_size > MINIMAX_M2_DECODE_SPLIT_MAX_BS:
+            return self.num_splits
+
+        forward_mode = forward_batch.forward_mode
+        if (
+            forward_mode.is_decode_or_idle()
+            or forward_mode.is_target_verify()
+            or forward_mode.is_draft_extend_v2()
+        ):
+            return MINIMAX_M2_DECODE_NUM_SPLITS
+        return self.num_splits
+
+    def _num_splits_for_no_mla_swa_kvcache(self, batch_size: Optional[int]) -> int:
+        # On Gemma4/S5000, forcing one split only wins at the largest captured
+        # decode batch. FA3 auto scheduling is 7-17 us faster per SWA layer at
+        # bs=1..7; with 50 SWA layers this materially improves the AIME tail.
+        if self._is_gemma4 and batch_size is not None and batch_size < 8:
+            return 0
+        return self.num_splits
+
+    def _num_splits_for_no_mla_call(
+        self,
+        forward_batch: SchedulerMetadataBatch,
+        *,
+        is_swa_layer: bool = False,
+        is_cross_attention: bool = False,
+        use_local_attn: bool = False,
+    ) -> int:
+        if is_swa_layer:
+            return self._num_splits_for_no_mla_swa_kvcache(
+                getattr(forward_batch, "batch_size", None)
+            )
+        if is_cross_attention or use_local_attn:
+            return self.num_splits
+        return self._num_splits_for_no_mla_full_kvcache(forward_batch)
+
+    def _is_context_parallel_extend(
+        self, forward_batch: SchedulerMetadataBatch
+    ) -> bool:
+        return (
+            forward_batch.forward_mode.is_context_parallel_extend()
+            and forward_batch.attn_cp_metadata is not None
+            and self.attn_cp_size > 1
+        )
+
+    # Scheduler metadata contract for MUSA FA3.
+    #
+    # `flash_attn_with_kvcache` always requires scheduler metadata. The no-MLA
+    # extend/decode call flow intentionally follows `FlashAttentionBackend`;
+    # MUSA only adds the precomputed scheduler metadata argument.
+    #
+    # no-MLA base paths:
+    # - EXTEND, DRAFT_EXTEND, TARGET_VERIFY: kvcache extend; uses
+    #   `metadata.scheduler_metadata`.
+    # - DECODE/IDLE: kvcache decode; uses `metadata.scheduler_metadata`.
+    # - Cross attention: kvcache over encoder KV; uses
+    #   `metadata.encoder_scheduler_metadata`, with `causal=False`.
+    # - Local attention: kvcache over local block table; uses
+    #   `metadata.local_attn_metadata.scheduler_metadata`.
+    #
+    # no-MLA variants:
+    # - SWA layers use `metadata.swa_scheduler_metadata`, generated from the
+    #   same cache/page/q lengths as the base path but with the uniform SWA
+    #   layer window size. Runtime calls pass
+    #   `window_size=(layer.sliding_window_size, 0)`.
+    # - Speculative cascade has two kvcache calls. The first call uses base/SWA
+    #   metadata for the prefix part. The second call uses
+    #   `forward_metadata_spec_decode_expand`, and SWA layers must select its
+    #   `swa_scheduler_metadata` instead of the full-attention metadata.
+    # - Context-parallel extend has prev/next kvcache calls. Full-attention CP
+    #   uses `cp_scheduler_metadata_prev/next`; SWA CP uses
+    #   `cp_swa_scheduler_metadata_prev/next`; local CP uses
+    #   `cp_local_scheduler_metadata_prev/next`.
+    #
+    # MLA paths use the scheduler-metadata wrapper with the absorbed layout
+    # (RoPE head dim plus KV LoRA rank).
+    def _build_scheduler_metadata(
+        self,
+        *,
+        max_seqlen_k: int,
+        cache_seqlens: torch.Tensor,
+        cu_seqlens_q: torch.Tensor,
+        cu_seqlens_k_new: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+        max_seqlen_q: int,
+        causal: bool,
+        window_size: tuple[int, int],
+        page_size: int,
+        attention_layout: Optional[AttentionLayout] = None,
+        num_splits: Optional[int] = None,
+    ) -> Optional[torch.Tensor]:
+        if cache_seqlens is None or cu_seqlens_q is None:
+            return None
+        num_heads_q, num_heads_kv, head_dim, v_head_dim = (
+            attention_layout or self._attention_layouts.full
+        )
+        return get_scheduler_metadata(
+            batch_size=cu_seqlens_q.shape[-1] - 1,
+            max_seqlen_q=max_seqlen_q,
+            max_seqlen_k=max(max_seqlen_k, 1),
+            num_heads_q=num_heads_q,
+            num_heads_kv=num_heads_kv,
+            headdim=head_dim,
+            headdim_v=v_head_dim,
+            cache_seqlens=cache_seqlens,
+            qkv_dtype=self.kv_cache_dtype,
+            cu_seqlens_q=cu_seqlens_q,
+            cu_seqlens_k_new=cu_seqlens_k_new,
+            page_size=page_size,
+            causal=causal,
+            window_size=window_size,
+            has_softcap=self.has_softcap,
+            num_splits=self.num_splits if num_splits is None else num_splits,
+        )
+
+    def _init_mla_scheduler_metadata(self) -> None:
+        if self.forward_metadata is None:
+            return
+        assert self._mla_attention_layout is not None
+        self.forward_metadata.scheduler_metadata = self._build_scheduler_metadata(
+            max_seqlen_k=self.forward_metadata.max_seq_len_k,
+            cache_seqlens=self.forward_metadata.cache_seqlens_int32,
+            cu_seqlens_q=self.forward_metadata.cu_seqlens_q,
+            cu_seqlens_k_new=self.forward_metadata.cu_seqlens_k,
+            max_seqlen_q=self.forward_metadata.max_seq_len_q,
+            causal=False,
+            window_size=(-1, -1),
+            page_size=self.page_size,
+            attention_layout=self._mla_attention_layout,
+            num_splits=self.num_splits,
+        )
+        metadata_expand = self.forward_metadata_spec_decode_expand
+        if metadata_expand is not None:
+            metadata_expand.scheduler_metadata = self._build_scheduler_metadata(
+                max_seqlen_k=metadata_expand.max_seq_len_k,
+                cache_seqlens=metadata_expand.cache_seqlens_int32,
+                cu_seqlens_q=metadata_expand.cu_seqlens_q,
+                cu_seqlens_k_new=metadata_expand.cu_seqlens_k,
+                max_seqlen_q=metadata_expand.max_seq_len_q,
+                causal=False,
+                window_size=(-1, -1),
+                page_size=self.page_size,
+                attention_layout=self._mla_attention_layout,
+                num_splits=self.num_splits,
+            )
+
+    def _mla_scheduler_metadata_for_decode_slice(
+        self,
+        metadata: MusaFlashAttentionMetadata,
+        cache_seqlens: torch.Tensor,
+        batch_index: int,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        assert self._mla_attention_layout is not None
+        cu_seqlens_q = metadata.cu_seqlens_q[batch_index : batch_index + 2]
+        cu_seqlens_q = cu_seqlens_q - cu_seqlens_q[0]
+        return self._build_scheduler_metadata(
+            max_seqlen_k=metadata.max_seq_len_k,
+            cache_seqlens=cache_seqlens[batch_index : batch_index + 1],
+            cu_seqlens_q=cu_seqlens_q,
+            cu_seqlens_k_new=None,
+            max_seqlen_q=1,
+            causal=False,
+            window_size=(-1, -1),
+            page_size=self.page_size,
+            attention_layout=self._mla_attention_layout,
+            num_splits=1,
+        )
+
+    def _graph_metadata_key(
+        self,
+        bs: int,
+        forward_mode: ForwardMode,
+        spec_info: Optional[SpecInput],
+    ) -> MusaCudaGraphMetadataKey:
+        if forward_mode.is_target_verify():
+            return MusaCudaGraphMetadataKey(
+                mode="target_verify",
+                batch_size=bs,
+                topk=self.topk,
+                num_draft_tokens=self.speculative_num_draft_tokens,
+            )
+        if forward_mode.is_decode_or_idle() and spec_info is not None:
+            return MusaCudaGraphMetadataKey(
+                mode="decode_spec",
+                batch_size=bs,
+                topk=self.topk,
+                speculative_step_id=self.speculative_step_id,
+            )
+        return MusaCudaGraphMetadataKey(mode="decode", batch_size=bs)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _append_graph_metadata_slots(
+        slots: list[MusaSchedulerMetadataSlot],
+        owner: Optional[MusaMetadataOwner],
+        name_prefix: str = "",
+    ) -> None:
+        if owner is None:
+            return
+
+        for attr in (
+            "scheduler_metadata",
+            "swa_scheduler_metadata",
+            "encoder_scheduler_metadata",
+        ):
+            tensor = getattr(owner, attr, None)
+            if isinstance(tensor, torch.Tensor):
+                slots.append(
+                    MusaSchedulerMetadataSlot(
+                        f"{name_prefix}{attr}", owner, attr, tensor
+                    )
+                )
+
+        local_metadata = getattr(owner, "local_attn_metadata", None)
+        if local_metadata is not None:
+            tensor = getattr(local_metadata, "scheduler_metadata", None)
+            if isinstance(tensor, torch.Tensor):
+                slots.append(
+                    MusaSchedulerMetadataSlot(
+                        f"{name_prefix}local_attn_metadata.scheduler_metadata",
+                        local_metadata,
+                        "scheduler_metadata",
+                        tensor,
+                    )
+                )
+
+        swa_spec_metadata = getattr(owner, "swa_spec_metadata", None)
+        if swa_spec_metadata is not None:
+            tensor = getattr(swa_spec_metadata, "swa_scheduler_metadata", None)
+            if isinstance(tensor, torch.Tensor):
+                slots.append(
+                    MusaSchedulerMetadataSlot(
+                        f"{name_prefix}swa_spec_metadata.swa_scheduler_metadata",
+                        swa_spec_metadata,
+                        "swa_scheduler_metadata",
+                        tensor,
+                    )
+                )
+
+        for side in ("prev", "next"):
+            for attr in (
+                f"cp_scheduler_metadata_{side}",
+                f"cp_swa_scheduler_metadata_{side}",
+                f"cp_local_scheduler_metadata_{side}",
+                f"cp_local_swa_scheduler_metadata_{side}",
+                f"cp_cu_seqlens_k_new_{side}",
+            ):
+                tensor = getattr(owner, attr, None)
+                if isinstance(tensor, torch.Tensor):
+                    slots.append(
+                        MusaSchedulerMetadataSlot(
+                            f"{name_prefix}{attr}", owner, attr, tensor
+                        )
+                    )
+
+    def _graph_metadata_slots(self) -> list[MusaSchedulerMetadataSlot]:
+        slots: list[MusaSchedulerMetadataSlot] = []
+        self._append_graph_metadata_slots(slots, self.forward_metadata)
+        self._append_graph_metadata_slots(
+            slots,
+            self.forward_metadata_spec_decode_expand,
+            name_prefix="spec_expand.",
+        )
+        return slots
+
+    def _capture_graph_scheduler_metadata(
+        self,
+        bs: int,
+        forward_mode: ForwardMode,
+        spec_info: Optional[SpecInput],
+    ) -> None:
+        key = self._graph_metadata_key(bs, forward_mode, spec_info)
+        self._captured_graph_metadata[key] = {
+            slot.name: slot.tensor for slot in self._graph_metadata_slots()
+        }
+
+    def _copy_fresh_metadata_to_graph_tensors(
+        self,
+        bs: int,
+        forward_mode: ForwardMode,
+        spec_info: Optional[SpecInput],
+    ) -> bool:
+        key = self._graph_metadata_key(bs, forward_mode, spec_info)
+        captured_tensors = self._captured_graph_metadata.get(key)
+        if captured_tensors is None:
+            return False
+
+        # CUDA graph captured the old tensor addresses. Replay generates fresh
+        # metadata, then copies the fresh values back into those old tensors.
+        fresh_slots = {slot.name: slot for slot in self._graph_metadata_slots()}
+        assert set(captured_tensors) == set(fresh_slots), (
+            "MUSA FA3 CUDA graph scheduler metadata slots changed between "
+            f"capture and replay: capture={sorted(captured_tensors)} "
+            f"replay={sorted(fresh_slots)}."
+        )
+        for name, captured_tensor in captured_tensors.items():
+            slot = fresh_slots[name]
+            fresh_tensor = slot.tensor
+            assert captured_tensor.shape == fresh_tensor.shape, (
+                "MUSA FA3 CUDA graph scheduler metadata shape changed for "
+                f"{name}: capture={tuple(captured_tensor.shape)} "
+                f"replay={tuple(fresh_tensor.shape)}."
+            )
+            assert captured_tensor.data_ptr() != fresh_tensor.data_ptr(), (
+                "MUSA FA3 CUDA graph replay scheduler metadata refresh did not "
+                f"produce a fresh tensor for {name}, key={key}, "
+                f"shape={tuple(captured_tensor.shape)}. This is a self-copy, "
+                "so the captured graph can keep using stale scheduler metadata."
+            )
+            captured_tensor.copy_(fresh_tensor)
+            setattr(slot.owner, slot.attribute, captured_tensor)
+        return True
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _max_seqlen_from_metadata(
+        max_seqlen_k: int, cache_seqlens: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> int:
+        # Prefer the static max length prepared by the base FA metadata path.
+        # The fallback reads `cache_seqlens.max().item()`, which synchronizes a
+        # device tensor to host and is not safe while graph capture is active.
+        # During capture, this fallback is only a shape placeholder for owners
+        # that do not carry a static max length; replay refreshes the captured
+        # scheduler tensor contents before graph launch.
+        if max_seqlen_k and max_seqlen_k > 0:
+            return max_seqlen_k
+        if get_is_capture_mode():
+            return 1
+        return int(cache_seqlens.max().item())
+
+    def _init_swa_scheduler_metadata(
+        self,
+        owner: MusaMetadataOwner,
+        attr: str,
+        *,
+        max_seqlen_k: int,
+        cache_seqlens: torch.Tensor,
+        cu_seqlens_q: torch.Tensor,
+        cu_seqlens_k_new: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+        max_seqlen_q: int,
+        causal: bool,
+        page_size: int,
+    ) -> None:
+        if not (
+            self.has_swa and self._attention_layouts.sliding_window_size is not None
+        ):
+            setattr(owner, attr, None)
+            return
+
+        # SWA scheduler metadata must be generated with the same window that the
+        # kernel will see at runtime. The model scan above enforces one uniform
+        # SWA window, so callers do not need to thread layer objects through
+        # metadata initialization.
+        setattr(
+            owner,
+            attr,
+            self._build_scheduler_metadata(
+                max_seqlen_k=max_seqlen_k,
+                cache_seqlens=cache_seqlens,
+                cu_seqlens_q=cu_seqlens_q,
+                cu_seqlens_k_new=cu_seqlens_k_new,
+                max_seqlen_q=max_seqlen_q,
+                causal=causal,
+                window_size=self._attention_layouts.sliding_window_size,
+                page_size=page_size,
+                attention_layout=self._attention_layouts.sliding_window,
+                num_splits=self._num_splits_for_no_mla_swa_kvcache(
+                    cu_seqlens_q.shape[-1] - 1
+                ),
+            ),
+        )
+
+    def _clear_cp_scheduler_metadata(
+        self, metadata: MusaFlashAttentionMetadata
+    ) -> None:
+        for side in ("prev", "next"):
+            for prefix in (
+                "cp",
+                "cp_swa",
+                "cp_local",
+                "cp_local_swa",
+            ):
+                setattr(metadata, f"{prefix}_scheduler_metadata_{side}", None)
+            setattr(metadata, f"cp_cu_seqlens_k_new_{side}", None)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _cp_side_lengths(
+        cp_meta: BaseContextParallelMetadata, side: str
+    ) -> tuple[int, int, torch.Tensor, int]:
+        if side == "prev":
+            q_lens = cp_meta.actual_seq_q_prev_tensor
+            k_lens = cp_meta.kv_len_prev_tensor
+        elif side == "next":
+            q_lens = cp_meta.actual_seq_q_next_tensor
+            k_lens = cp_meta.kv_len_next_tensor
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(f"unknown CP side: {side}")
+        if q_lens is None or k_lens is None:
+            raise ValueError(f"CP metadata is missing {side} sequence lengths")
+        return (
+            int(q_lens.sum().item()),
+            int(k_lens.max().item()),
+            k_lens,
+            int(q_lens.max().item()),
+        )
+
+    def _init_cp_self_scheduler_metadata(
+        self,
+        metadata: MusaFlashAttentionMetadata,
+        side: str,
+        *,
+        q_len: int,
+        k_len: int,
+        k_len_tensor: torch.Tensor,
+        cu_seqlens_q: torch.Tensor,
+        cu_seqlens_k_new: torch.Tensor,
+        attention_layout: Optional[AttentionLayout] = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        full_attr = f"cp_scheduler_metadata_{side}"
+        swa_attr = f"cp_swa_scheduler_metadata_{side}"
+        if attention_layout is not None or self._attention_layouts.has_full_attention:
+            setattr(
+                metadata,
+                full_attr,
+                self._build_scheduler_metadata(
+                    max_seqlen_k=k_len,
+                    cache_seqlens=k_len_tensor,
+                    cu_seqlens_q=cu_seqlens_q,
+                    cu_seqlens_k_new=cu_seqlens_k_new,
+                    max_seqlen_q=q_len,
+                    causal=True,
+                    window_size=(-1, -1),
+                    page_size=self.page_size,
+                    attention_layout=attention_layout,
+                ),
+            )
+        else:
+            setattr(metadata, full_attr, None)
+
+        self._init_swa_scheduler_metadata(
+            metadata,
+            swa_attr,
+            max_seqlen_k=k_len,
+            cache_seqlens=k_len_tensor,
+            cu_seqlens_q=cu_seqlens_q,
+            cu_seqlens_k_new=cu_seqlens_k_new,
+            max_seqlen_q=q_len,
+            causal=True,
+            page_size=self.page_size,
+        )
+
+    def _init_cp_local_scheduler_metadata(
+        self,
+        metadata: MusaFlashAttentionMetadata,
+        local_metadata: Optional[MusaLocalAttentionMetadata],
+        side: str,
+        *,
+        q_len: int,
+        k_len: int,
+        k_len_tensor: torch.Tensor,
+        cu_seqlens_q: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> None:
+        local_attr = f"cp_local_scheduler_metadata_{side}"
+        local_swa_attr = f"cp_local_swa_scheduler_metadata_{side}"
+        # Local attention has separate block tables. Its scheduler metadata uses
+        # the same CP q/cache lengths, but no `cu_seqlens_k_new` because the local
+        # path does not append newly gathered KV through the normal paged-cache
+        # table in the callback.
+        if local_metadata is not None and self._attention_layouts.has_local_attention:
+            setattr(
+                metadata,
+                local_attr,
+                self._build_scheduler_metadata(
+                    max_seqlen_k=k_len,
+                    cache_seqlens=k_len_tensor,
+                    cu_seqlens_q=cu_seqlens_q,
+                    cu_seqlens_k_new=None,
+                    max_seqlen_q=q_len,
+                    causal=True,
+                    window_size=(-1, -1),
+                    page_size=self.page_size,
+                ),
+            )
+        else:
+            setattr(metadata, local_attr, None)
+
+        if (
+            local_metadata is not None
+            and self._attention_layouts.has_sliding_window_local_attention
+        ):
+            self._init_swa_scheduler_metadata(
+                metadata,
+                local_swa_attr,
+                max_seqlen_k=k_len,
+                cache_seqlens=k_len_tensor,
+                cu_seqlens_q=cu_seqlens_q,
+                cu_seqlens_k_new=None,
+                max_seqlen_q=q_len,
+                causal=True,
+                page_size=self.page_size,
+            )
+        else:
+            setattr(metadata, local_swa_attr, None)
+
+    def _init_cp_side_scheduler_metadata(
+        self,
+        metadata: MusaFlashAttentionMetadata,
+        local_metadata: Optional[MusaLocalAttentionMetadata],
+        cp_meta: BaseContextParallelMetadata,
+        side: str,
+        device: torch.device,
+        attention_layout: Optional[AttentionLayout] = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        # CP extend is split into two single-sequence kvcache calls by the
+        # selected strategy: prev and next. Each side has its own q length
+        # Each CP side has a distinct visible KV length, so wrapper metadata must
+        # use matching CP-local cu_seqlens instead of the full extend cu_seqlens.
+        q_total, k_len, k_len_tensor, q_len = self._cp_side_lengths(cp_meta, side)
+        cu_seqlens_q = getattr(cp_meta, f"cu_seqlens_q_{side}_tensor", None)
+        cu_seqlens_k_new = getattr(cp_meta, f"cu_seqlens_kv_{side}_tensor", None)
+        if cu_seqlens_q is None:
+            cu_seqlens_q = torch.tensor([0, q_total], device=device, dtype=torch.int32)
+        if cu_seqlens_k_new is None:
+            cu_seqlens_k_new = torch.tensor(
+                [0, k_len], device=device, dtype=torch.int32
+            )
+        setattr(metadata, f"cp_cu_seqlens_k_new_{side}", cu_seqlens_k_new)
+        self._init_cp_self_scheduler_metadata(
+            metadata,
+            side,
+            q_len=q_len,
+            k_len=k_len,
+            k_len_tensor=k_len_tensor,
+            cu_seqlens_q=cu_seqlens_q,
+            cu_seqlens_k_new=cu_seqlens_k_new,
+            attention_layout=attention_layout,
+        )
+        self._init_cp_local_scheduler_metadata(
+            metadata,
+            local_metadata,
+            side,
+            q_len=q_len,
+            k_len=k_len,
+            k_len_tensor=k_len_tensor,
+            cu_seqlens_q=cu_seqlens_q,
+        )
+
+    def _init_cp_scheduler_metadata(
+        self,
+        forward_batch: ForwardBatch,
+        local_metadata: Optional[MusaLocalAttentionMetadata],
+        attention_layout: Optional[AttentionLayout] = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        metadata = self.forward_metadata

This attribute list is hand-maintained, so any metadata field added later (another CP variant, another local-attention tensor) silently escapes replay refresh. The only thing that catches the drift is the slot-set `assert` in `_copy_fresh_metadata_to_graph_tensors()` — which `-O` strips.

Suggest deriving the slot set from `dataclasses.fields()` on the metadata classes, or defining one canonical name list that both `_clear_cp_scheduler_metadata()` (`:792`) and this function consume, so add/clear/refresh cannot drift apart.

Two problems with the Gemma4 split policy:

1. The comments contradict each other. `:219-222` says Gemma4 SWA is faster *without* split-KV; this comment says auto (`num_splits=0`) is faster at `bs < 8` and that split=1 wins above it. One of them is stale.
2. `self.num_splits = 1` (`:223`) silently overrides `--flash-attention-num-splits` for this model, and the numbers quoted here ("7-17 us", "the AIME tail") have no measurement attached, while the PR body states "No performance claim is made".

Either attach the benchmark — per-layer and end-to-end, both `bs` regimes — or drop the tuning and keep the user's flag. The MiniMax-M2 special case (`:415-433`) has the same issue: two model identities hardcoded inside a device backend belongs in a tuning table.

detail.body:
## Motivation

FlashAttention 3 is the common attention implementation used by several SGLang model families. The MUSA backend needs the same metadata lifecycle and forward coverage as the parent backend so that models using GQA, MLA, sliding-window attention, encoder/cross attention, embedding, speculative decoding, and context-parallel full attention can share one attention implementation on Moore Threads devices. This change ports the backend behavior while keeping the common attention stack unchanged.

## Supported attention paths

| Attention path | Coverage | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Causal full attention | Supported | GQA/MQA layouts and paged KV cache |
| MLA | Supported | Wrapper-generated scheduler metadata and absorbed MLA layout |
| Sliding-window attention | Supported | Separate window metadata and SWA KV write locations |
| Cross/encoder attention | Supported in backend/tests | Encoder scheduler metadata and translated KV locations |
| Bidirectional / encoder-only | Supported | Non-causal and symmetric window handling |
| Embedding / skip-KV | Supported | No KV-pool writes; eager path validated |
| Speculative decoding | Supported | Multi-step metadata and graph paths |
| Context-parallel full attention | Supported | Reuses the parent CP strategy for KV materialization and attention dispatch |
| Context-parallel MLA | Implemented and runtime-validated on DeepSeek-V2-Lite | MLA uses per-side wrapper metadata; 128K TP8/CP2 passed with radix cache on/off |
| Context-parallel SWA/local | Implemented and runtime-validated on MiMo-V2.5 | TP8/CP2, 128000-token requests passed with Radix cache enabled and disabled |

## Modifications

- Add the MUSA FA3 metadata and forward paths for the supported attention paths above, including eager execution and graph capture/replay.
- Reuse the parent CP strategy for dense full-attention KV materialization and the two-side CP attention dispatch instead of the deprecated platform shim.
- Keep public backend signatures, annotations, and parent-compatible naming aligned with the upstream FA3 backend.
- Generate scheduler metadata through the installed `flash_attn_interface` wrapper; no direct package-level MATE dependency is added to the backend.
- Preserve parent behavior for physical KV-location translation, cross-attention metadata, SWA writes, skip-KV, bidirectional attention, scales, and multi-step speculative state.
- Keep the existing platform prefill-CP validation unchanged; attention CP is selected separately through `attn_cp_size` and the parent strategy.
- Add registered CPU metadata tests covering interface parity, metadata conversion, MLA, cross attention, SWA locations, skip-KV/bidirectional behavior, multi-step state, split policy, and metadata forwarding.

## Validation

| Test | Configuration | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Registered unit tests | CPU mock metadata suite, 15 tests | 15/15 passed in the target 5.2 image |
| Static checks | isort, Ruff, format, compileall, diff check | Changed-file checks passed; upstream fix #47078 has landed and the branch is rebased on it |
| GQA backend lifecycle | 131072-token paged KV, eager + graph | Passed; finite output and changing replay |
| MLA backend lifecycle | 131072-token paged KV, wrapper metadata, eager + graph | Passed; output shape 1x16x512 |
| SWA backend lifecycle | 131072-token paged KV, window 1024, eager + graph | Passed |
| Qwen2.5-7B GQA | 128K input, graph and eager | HTTP 200 with four output tokens |
| Radix cache | Same 128K request, cache on/off | 127936 cached tokens with cache on; zero with cache off |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite MLA | 128K eager request | HTTP 200 with four output tokens |
| MiMo-V2.5 SWA | TP8/CP2, window 128, 128000-token eager request | PASS: HTTP 200 with one-token completion, Radix off and on; repeated cache-on request reported 127936 cached tokens |
| Qwen3-VL + Eagle3 | 128K speculative request | Target/draft graph paths passed |
| Embedding / skip-KV | Qwen2.5-7B, 128K encode request | Finite 3584-dimensional embedding |
| GSM8K multi-round | 20 questions, 3 rounds, Radix on/off | 71.67% vs 70.00%; no systematic cache regression |
| Context-parallel GQA | TP2, CP2, Qwen3-4B, 128000-token input | Passed in the 5.2 runtime on the BF16 path; HTTP 200, four-token completion, 48.0s end-to-end latency; 127936 cached tokens on the repeated request |
| Context-parallel MLA | Parent-aligned implementation and metadata paths | PASS: DeepSeek-V2-Lite TP8/CP2, 128002 prompt tokens; cache on/off both returned HTTP 200, and cache-on repeat reported cached-token 128000 (5.2.0 image) |
| Context-parallel SWA/local | MiMo-V2.5 FP8, TP8/CP2, window 128, 128000-token eager request | PASS: cache-off and cache-on requests returned HTTP 200; repeated cache-on request reported 127936 cached tokens |

No performance claim is made. The CP implementation follows the parent strategy for full, MLA, SWA, and local attention metadata paths. Runtime evidence covers dense GQA, MLA, and SWA/local attention.

## Checklist

- [x] Common attention components unchanged.
- [x] Changed-file community formatting and lint checks.
- [x] Rebased after upstream fix #47078 resolved the unrelated full-repository lint failure.
- [x] Registered CPU tests.
- [x] Real long-context MUSA validation for GQA, MLA, SWA, eager, graph, embedding, speculative decoding, and cache on/off.
- [x] CP implementation follows the parent strategy for full attention and the corresponding MLA/SWA/local metadata paths.
- [x] Dense CP implementation removes the deprecated shim call.
- [x] Full 2-rank CP acceptance on the 5.2 runtime (Qwen3 GQA, TP2/CP2, 128K input).
- [x] Model-level 128K CP MLA request with radix cache enabled and disabled (DeepSeek-V2-Lite, TP8/CP2).
- [x] Model-specific 128K CP request for SWA/local attention (MiMo-V2.5 FP8, TP8/CP2, Radix cache enabled and disabled).

The boolean return of `_copy_fresh_metadata_to_graph_tensors()` is dropped here. When the key is absent — a `bs`/`spec_info` combination that was never captured — the helper returns `False` and this call becomes a no-op, so the graph replays with the metadata that was baked in at capture time. That is exactly the staleness this function exists to prevent, and it is completely silent.

Please raise (or at least log and skip the replay) when it returns `False`. Same applies to the three `assert`s inside the helper (`:711`, `:719`, `:724`): slot-set equality, shape equality and the self-copy guard are production invariants, but `python -O` deletes them and then `copy_` runs against a mismatched tensor.

inline_comments.body:
`causal=False` is hardcoded into the MLA metadata here and at `:561` and `:583`, but the MLA calls pass `causal=causal` (`:2039` CP, `:2075` non-CP). `causal` is an argument to `get_scheduler_metadata` (`:531`), so the metadata is specialized on it.

- If MATE uses the metadata's causal flag, MLA **prefill** builds a non-causal plan and runs it causally.
- If MATE ignores it when `scheduler_metadata` is supplied, the call-site argument is misleading and should be dropped or documented.

This is invisible to the current evidence: DeepSeek-V2-Lite 128K with four output tokens is decode-shaped, where `q_len == 1` makes causal and non-causal identical. Can you confirm the contract, and add a prefill accuracy check?

inline_comments.body: The CP side is inferred from tensor identity. A caller that passes an equal-but-not-identical tensor silently gets the `next`-side metadata — a wrong-side scheduler plan with no error anywhere. Please pass `side: str` explicitly from the two call sites (`:1776`, `:2043`); it is one parameter and the failure mode disappears.

+        # state. They let `_init_no_mla_scheduler_metadata` avoid building
+        # metadata for layer families that cannot be reached by this model.
+        # Cross-attention layers are tracked separately because they use encoder
+        # KV lengths and do not participate in the self-attention layout check.
+        full_layouts: set[AttentionLayout] = set()
+        swa_layouts: set[AttentionLayout] = set()
+        swa_window_sizes: set[int] = set()
+        has_full_attention_layer = False
+        has_local_attention_layer = False
+        has_cross_attention_layer = False
+        has_swa_local_attention_layer = False
+        for module in model_runner.model.modules():
+            if not isinstance(module, RadixAttention):
+                continue
+
+            if getattr(module, "is_cross_attention", False):
+                has_cross_attention_layer = True
+                continue
+
+            if (
+                module.sliding_window_size is not None
+                and module.sliding_window_size > -1
+            ):
+                swa_layouts.add(cls._layer_attention_layout(module))
+                swa_window_sizes.add(module.sliding_window_size)
+                has_swa_local_attention_layer |= bool(
+                    getattr(module, "use_irope", False)
+                )
+            else:
+                full_layouts.add(cls._layer_attention_layout(module))
+                has_full_attention_layer = True
+
+            has_local_attention_layer |= bool(getattr(module, "use_irope", False))
+
+        full_layouts = sorted(full_layouts)
+        swa_layouts = sorted(swa_layouts)
+        if len(full_layouts) > 1 or len(swa_layouts) > 1:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "MUSA FA3 no-MLA scheduler metadata assumes one uniform "
+                "self-attention layout for all full-attention layers and one "
+                "uniform self-attention layout for all SWA layers; full and "
+                f"SWA layouts may differ. Got full={full_layouts} "
+                f"and swa={swa_layouts}."
+            )
+
+        swa_window_sizes = sorted(swa_window_sizes)
+        if len(swa_window_sizes) > 1:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "MUSA FA3 no-MLA scheduler metadata assumes one uniform SWA "
+                f"window size. Got {swa_window_sizes}."
+            )
+
+        full_layout = full_layouts[0] if full_layouts else None
+        swa_layout = swa_layouts[0] if swa_layouts else full_layout
+        full_layout = full_layout if full_layout is not None else swa_layout
+        swa_window_size = (
+            (swa_window_sizes[0], 0) if len(swa_window_sizes) == 1 else None
+        )
+        return MusaAttentionLayouts(
+            full=full_layout,
+            sliding_window=swa_layout,
+            sliding_window_size=swa_window_size,
+            has_full_attention=has_full_attention_layer,
+            has_local_attention=has_local_attention_layer,
+            has_cross_attention=has_cross_attention_layer,
+            has_sliding_window_local_attention=has_swa_local_attention_layer,
+        )
+
+    def _needs_no_mla_kvcache_scheduler_metadata(
+        self,
+        forward_batch: SchedulerMetadataBatch,
+        *,
+        is_cross_attention: bool = False,
+    ) -> bool:
+        forward_mode = forward_batch.forward_mode
+        extend_prefix_lens_cpu = getattr(forward_batch, "extend_prefix_lens_cpu", None)
+        extend_with_prefix = extend_prefix_lens_cpu is not None and any(
+            extend_prefix_lens_cpu
+        )
+        return is_cross_attention or (
+            forward_mode.is_decode_or_idle()
+            or forward_mode.is_target_verify()
+            or forward_mode.is_draft_extend_v2()
+            or (
+                forward_mode.is_extend_or_draft_extend_or_mixed(
+                    include_draft_extend_v2=True
+                )
+                and extend_with_prefix
+            )
+        )
+
+    def _num_splits_for_no_mla_full_kvcache(
+        self, forward_batch: SchedulerMetadataBatch
+    ) -> int:
+        """Keep MiniMax-M2 decode-like full-attention metadata/calls aligned."""
+        if not self._is_minimax_m2:
+            return self.full_attention_num_splits
+
+        batch_size = getattr(forward_batch, "batch_size", None)
+        if batch_size is None or batch_size > MINIMAX_M2_DECODE_SPLIT_MAX_BS:
+            return self.num_splits
+
+        forward_mode = forward_batch.forward_mode
+        if (
+            forward_mode.is_decode_or_idle()
+            or forward_mode.is_target_verify()
+            or forward_mode.is_draft_extend_v2()
+        ):
+            return MINIMAX_M2_DECODE_NUM_SPLITS
+        return self.num_splits
+
+    def _num_splits_for_no_mla_swa_kvcache(self, batch_size: Optional[int]) -> int:
+        # On Gemma4/S5000, forcing one split only wins at the largest captured
+        # decode batch. FA3 auto scheduling is 7-17 us faster per SWA layer at
+        # bs=1..7; with 50 SWA layers this materially improves the AIME tail.
+        if self._is_gemma4 and batch_size is not None and batch_size < 8:
+            return 0
+        return self.num_splits
+
+    def _num_splits_for_no_mla_call(
+        self,
+        forward_batch: SchedulerMetadataBatch,
+        *,
+        is_swa_layer: bool = False,
+        is_cross_attention: bool = False,
+        use_local_attn: bool = False,
+    ) -> int:
+        if is_swa_layer:
+            return self._num_splits_for_no_mla_swa_kvcache(
+                getattr(forward_batch, "batch_size", None)
+            )
+        if is_cross_attention or use_local_attn:
+            return self.num_splits
+        return self._num_splits_for_no_mla_full_kvcache(forward_batch)
+
+    def _is_context_parallel_extend(
+        self, forward_batch: SchedulerMetadataBatch
+    ) -> bool:
+        return (
+            forward_batch.forward_mode.is_context_parallel_extend()
+            and forward_batch.attn_cp_metadata is not None
+            and self.attn_cp_size > 1
+        )
+
+    # Scheduler metadata contract for MUSA FA3.
+    #
+    # `flash_attn_with_kvcache` always requires scheduler metadata. The no-MLA
+    # extend/decode call flow intentionally follows `FlashAttentionBackend`;
+    # MUSA only adds the precomputed scheduler metadata argument.
+    #
+    # no-MLA base paths:
+    # - EXTEND, DRAFT_EXTEND, TARGET_VERIFY: kvcache extend; uses
+    #   `metadata.scheduler_metadata`.
+    # - DECODE/IDLE: kvcache decode; uses `metadata.scheduler_metadata`.
+    # - Cross attention: kvcache over encoder KV; uses
+    #   `metadata.encoder_scheduler_metadata`, with `causal=False`.
+    # - Local attention: kvcache over local block table; uses
+    #   `metadata.local_attn_metadata.scheduler_metadata`.
+    #
+    # no-MLA variants:
+    # - SWA layers use `metadata.swa_scheduler_metadata`, generated from the
+    #   same cache/page/q lengths as the base path but with the uniform SWA
+    #   layer window size. Runtime calls pass
+    #   `window_size=(layer.sliding_window_size, 0)`.
+    # - Speculative cascade has two kvcache calls. The first call uses base/SWA
+    #   metadata for the prefix part. The second call uses
+    #   `forward_metadata_spec_decode_expand`, and SWA layers must select its
+    #   `swa_scheduler_metadata` instead of the full-attention metadata.
+    # - Context-parallel extend has prev/next kvcache calls. Full-attention CP
+    #   uses `cp_scheduler_metadata_prev/next`; SWA CP uses
+    #   `cp_swa_scheduler_metadata_prev/next`; local CP uses
+    #   `cp_local_scheduler_metadata_prev/next`.
+    #
+    # MLA paths use the scheduler-metadata wrapper with the absorbed layout
+    # (RoPE head dim plus KV LoRA rank).
+    def _build_scheduler_metadata(
+        self,
+        *,
+        max_seqlen_k: int,
+        cache_seqlens: torch.Tensor,
+        cu_seqlens_q: torch.Tensor,
+        cu_seqlens_k_new: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+        max_seqlen_q: int,
+        causal: bool,
+        window_size: tuple[int, int],
+        page_size: int,
+        attention_layout: Optional[AttentionLayout] = None,
+        num_splits: Optional[int] = None,
+    ) -> Optional[torch.Tensor]:
+        if cache_seqlens is None or cu_seqlens_q is None:
+            return None
+        num_heads_q, num_heads_kv, head_dim, v_head_dim = (
+            attention_layout or self._attention_layouts.full
+        )
+        return get_scheduler_metadata(
+            batch_size=cu_seqlens_q.shape[-1] - 1,
+            max_seqlen_q=max_seqlen_q,
+            max_seqlen_k=max(max_seqlen_k, 1),
+            num_heads_q=num_heads_q,
+            num_heads_kv=num_heads_kv,
+            headdim=head_dim,
+            headdim_v=v_head_dim,
+            cache_seqlens=cache_seqlens,
+            qkv_dtype=self.kv_cache_dtype,
+            cu_seqlens_q=cu_seqlens_q,
+            cu_seqlens_k_new=cu_seqlens_k_new,
+            page_size=page_size,
+            causal=causal,
+            window_size=window_size,
+            has_softcap=self.has_softcap,
+            num_splits=self.num_splits if num_splits is None else num_splits,
+        )
+
+    def _init_mla_scheduler_metadata(self) -> None:
+        if self.forward_metadata is None:
+            return
+        assert self._mla_attention_layout is not None
+        self.forward_metadata.scheduler_metadata = self._build_scheduler_metadata(
+            max_seqlen_k=self.forward_metadata.max_seq_len_k,
+            cache_seqlens=self.forward_metadata.cache_seqlens_int32,
+            cu_seqlens_q=self.forward_metadata.cu_seqlens_q,
+            cu_seqlens_k_new=self.forward_metadata.cu_seqlens_k,
+            max_seqlen_q=self.forward_metadata.max_seq_len_q,
+            causal=False,
+            window_size=(-1, -1),
+            page_size=self.page_size,
+            attention_layout=self._mla_attention_layout,
+            num_splits=self.num_splits,
+        )
+        metadata_expand = self.forward_metadata_spec_decode_expand
+        if metadata_expand is not None:
+            metadata_expand.scheduler_metadata = self._build_scheduler_metadata(
+                max_seqlen_k=metadata_expand.max_seq_len_k,
+                cache_seqlens=metadata_expand.cache_seqlens_int32,
+                cu_seqlens_q=metadata_expand.cu_seqlens_q,
+                cu_seqlens_k_new=metadata_expand.cu_seqlens_k,
+                max_seqlen_q=metadata_expand.max_seq_len_q,
+                causal=False,
+                window_size=(-1, -1),
+                page_size=self.page_size,
+                attention_layout=self._mla_attention_layout,
+                num_splits=self.num_splits,
+            )
+
+    def _mla_scheduler_metadata_for_decode_slice(
+        self,
+        metadata: MusaFlashAttentionMetadata,
+        cache_seqlens: torch.Tensor,
+        batch_index: int,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        assert self._mla_attention_layout is not None
+        cu_seqlens_q = metadata.cu_seqlens_q[batch_index : batch_index + 2]
+        cu_seqlens_q = cu_seqlens_q - cu_seqlens_q[0]
+        return self._build_scheduler_metadata(
+            max_seqlen_k=metadata.max_seq_len_k,
+            cache_seqlens=cache_seqlens[batch_index : batch_index + 1],
+            cu_seqlens_q=cu_seqlens_q,
+            cu_seqlens_k_new=None,
+            max_seqlen_q=1,
+            causal=False,
+            window_size=(-1, -1),
+            page_size=self.page_size,
+            attention_layout=self._mla_attention_layout,
+            num_splits=1,
+        )
+
+    def _graph_metadata_key(
+        self,
+        bs: int,
+        forward_mode: ForwardMode,
+        spec_info: Optional[SpecInput],
+    ) -> MusaCudaGraphMetadataKey:
+        if forward_mode.is_target_verify():
+            return MusaCudaGraphMetadataKey(
+                mode="target_verify",
+                batch_size=bs,
+                topk=self.topk,
+                num_draft_tokens=self.speculative_num_draft_tokens,
+            )
+        if forward_mode.is_decode_or_idle() and spec_info is not None:
+            return MusaCudaGraphMetadataKey(
+                mode="decode_spec",
+                batch_size=bs,
+                topk=self.topk,
+                speculative_step_id=self.speculative_step_id,
+            )
+        return MusaCudaGraphMetadataKey(mode="decode", batch_size=bs)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _append_graph_metadata_slots(
+        slots: list[MusaSchedulerMetadataSlot],
+        owner: Optional[MusaMetadataOwner],
+        name_prefix: str = "",
+    ) -> None:
+        if owner is None:
+            return
+
+        for attr in (
+            "scheduler_metadata",
+            "swa_scheduler_metadata",
+            "encoder_scheduler_metadata",
+        ):
+            tensor = getattr(owner, attr, None)
+            if isinstance(tensor, torch.Tensor):
+                slots.append(
+                    MusaSchedulerMetadataSlot(
+                        f"{name_prefix}{attr}", owner, attr, tensor
+                    )
+                )
+
+        local_metadata = getattr(owner, "local_attn_metadata", None)
+        if local_metadata is not None:
+            tensor = getattr(local_metadata, "scheduler_metadata", None)
+            if isinstance(tensor, torch.Tensor):
+                slots.append(
+                    MusaSchedulerMetadataSlot(
+                        f"{name_prefix}local_attn_metadata.scheduler_metadata",
+                        local_metadata,
+                        "scheduler_metadata",
+                        tensor,
+                    )
+                )
+
+        swa_spec_metadata = getattr(owner, "swa_spec_metadata", None)
+        if swa_spec_metadata is not None:
+            tensor = getattr(swa_spec_metadata, "swa_scheduler_metadata", None)
+            if isinstance(tensor, torch.Tensor):
+                slots.append(
+                    MusaSchedulerMetadataSlot(
+                        f"{name_prefix}swa_spec_metadata.swa_scheduler_metadata",
+                        swa_spec_metadata,
+                        "swa_scheduler_metadata",
+                        tensor,
+                    )
+                )
+
+        for side in ("prev", "next"):
+            for attr in (
+                f"cp_scheduler_metadata_{side}",
+                f"cp_swa_scheduler_metadata_{side}",
+                f"cp_local_scheduler_metadata_{side}",
+                f"cp_local_swa_scheduler_metadata_{side}",
+                f"cp_cu_seqlens_k_new_{side}",
+            ):
+                tensor = getattr(owner, attr, None)
+                if isinstance(tensor, torch.Tensor):
+                    slots.append(
+                        MusaSchedulerMetadataSlot(
+                            f"{name_prefix}{attr}", owner, attr, tensor
+                        )
+                    )
+
+    def _graph_metadata_slots(self) -> list[MusaSchedulerMetadataSlot]:
+        slots: list[MusaSchedulerMetadataSlot] = []
+        self._append_graph_metadata_slots(slots, self.forward_metadata)
+        self._append_graph_metadata_slots(
+            slots,
+            self.forward_metadata_spec_decode_expand,
+            name_prefix="spec_expand.",
+        )
+        return slots
+
+    def _capture_graph_scheduler_metadata(
+        self,
+        bs: int,
+        forward_mode: ForwardMode,
+        spec_info: Optional[SpecInput],
+    ) -> None:
+        key = self._graph_metadata_key(bs, forward_mode, spec_info)
+        self._captured_graph_metadata[key] = {
+            slot.name: slot.tensor for slot in self._graph_metadata_slots()
+        }
+
+    def _copy_fresh_metadata_to_graph_tensors(
+        self,
+        bs: int,
+        forward_mode: ForwardMode,
+        spec_info: Optional[SpecInput],
+    ) -> bool:
+        key = self._graph_metadata_key(bs, forward_mode, spec_info)
+        captured_tensors = self._captured_graph_metadata.get(key)
+        if captured_tensors is None:
+            return False
+
+        # CUDA graph captured the old tensor addresses. Replay generates fresh
+        # metadata, then copies the fresh values back into those old tensors.
+        fresh_slots = {slot.name: slot for slot in self._graph_metadata_slots()}
+        assert set(captured_tensors) == set(fresh_slots), (
+            "MUSA FA3 CUDA graph scheduler metadata slots changed between "
+            f"capture and replay: capture={sorted(captured_tensors)} "
+            f"replay={sorted(fresh_slots)}."
+        )
+        for name, captured_tensor in captured_tensors.items():
+            slot = fresh_slots[name]
+            fresh_tensor = slot.tensor
+            assert captured_tensor.shape == fresh_tensor.shape, (
+                "MUSA FA3 CUDA graph scheduler metadata shape changed for "
+                f"{name}: capture={tuple(captured_tensor.shape)} "
+                f"replay={tuple(fresh_tensor.shape)}."
+            )
+            assert captured_tensor.data_ptr() != fresh_tensor.data_ptr(), (
+                "MUSA FA3 CUDA graph replay scheduler metadata refresh did not "
+                f"produce a fresh tensor for {name}, key={key}, "
+                f"shape={tuple(captured_tensor.shape)}. This is a self-copy, "
+                "so the captured graph can keep using stale scheduler metadata."
+            )
+            captured_tensor.copy_(fresh_tensor)
+            setattr(slot.owner, slot.attribute, captured_tensor)
+        return True
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _max_seqlen_from_metadata(
+        max_seqlen_k: int, cache_seqlens: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> int:
+        # Prefer the static max length prepared by the base FA metadata path.
+        # The fallback reads `cache_seqlens.max().item()`, which synchronizes a
+        # device tensor to host and is not safe while graph capture is active.
+        # During capture, this fallback is only a shape placeholder for owners
+        # that do not carry a static max length; replay refreshes the captured
+        # scheduler tensor contents before graph launch.
+        if max_seqlen_k and max_seqlen_k > 0:
+            return max_seqlen_k
+        if get_is_capture_mode():
+            return 1
+        return int(cache_seqlens.max().item())
+
+    def _init_swa_scheduler_metadata(
+        self,
+        owner: MusaMetadataOwner,
+        attr: str,
+        *,
+        max_seqlen_k: int,
+        cache_seqlens: torch.Tensor,
+        cu_seqlens_q: torch.Tensor,
+        cu_seqlens_k_new: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+        max_seqlen_q: int,
+        causal: bool,
+        page_size: int,
+    ) -> None:
+        if not (
+            self.has_swa and self._attention_layouts.sliding_window_size is not None
+        ):
+            setattr(owner, attr, None)
+            return
+
+        # SWA scheduler metadata must be generated with the same window that the
+        # kernel will see at runtime. The model scan above enforces one uniform
+        # SWA window, so callers do not need to thread layer objects through
+        # metadata initialization.
+        setattr(
+            owner,
+            attr,
+            self._build_scheduler_metadata(
+                max_seqlen_k=max_seqlen_k,
+                cache_seqlens=cache_seqlens,
+                cu_seqlens_q=cu_seqlens_q,
+                cu_seqlens_k_new=cu_seqlens_k_new,
+                max_seqlen_q=max_seqlen_q,
+                causal=causal,
+                window_size=self._attention_layouts.sliding_window_size,
+                page_size=page_size,
+                attention_layout=self._attention_layouts.sliding_window,
+                num_splits=self._num_splits_for_no_mla_swa_kvcache(
+                    cu_seqlens_q.shape[-1] - 1
+                ),
+            ),
+        )
+
+    def _clear_cp_scheduler_metadata(
+        self, metadata: MusaFlashAttentionMetadata
+    ) -> None:
+        for side in ("prev", "next"):
+            for prefix in (
+                "cp",
+                "cp_swa",
+                "cp_local",
+                "cp_local_swa",
+            ):
+                setattr(metadata, f"{prefix}_scheduler_metadata_{side}", None)
+            setattr(metadata, f"cp_cu_seqlens_k_new_{side}", None)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _cp_side_lengths(
+        cp_meta: BaseContextParallelMetadata, side: str
+    ) -> tuple[int, int, torch.Tensor, int]:
+        if side == "prev":
+            q_lens = cp_meta.actual_seq_q_prev_tensor
+            k_lens = cp_meta.kv_len_prev_tensor
+        elif side == "next":
+            q_lens = cp_meta.actual_seq_q_next_tensor
+            k_lens = cp_meta.kv_len_next_tensor
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(f"unknown CP side: {side}")
+        if q_lens is None or k_lens is None:
+            raise ValueError(f"CP metadata is missing {side} sequence lengths")
+        return (
+            int(q_lens.sum().item()),
+            int(k_lens.max().item()),
+            k_lens,
+            int(q_lens.max().item()),
+        )
+
+    def _init_cp_self_scheduler_metadata(
+        self,
+        metadata: MusaFlashAttentionMetadata,
+        side: str,
+        *,
+        q_len: int,
+        k_len: int,
+        k_len_tensor: torch.Tensor,
+        cu_seqlens_q: torch.Tensor,
+        cu_seqlens_k_new: torch.Tensor,
+        attention_layout: Optional[AttentionLayout] = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        full_attr = f"cp_scheduler_metadata_{side}"
+        swa_attr = f"cp_swa_scheduler_metadata_{side}"
+        if attention_layout is not None or self._attention_layouts.has_full_attention:
+            setattr(
+                metadata,
+                full_attr,
+                self._build_scheduler_metadata(
+                    max_seqlen_k=k_len,
+                    cache_seqlens=k_len_tensor,
+                    cu_seqlens_q=cu_seqlens_q,
+                    cu_seqlens_k_new=cu_seqlens_k_new,
+                    max_seqlen_q=q_len,
+                    causal=True,
+                    window_size=(-1, -1),
+                    page_size=self.page_size,
+                    attention_layout=attention_layout,
+                ),
+            )
+        else:
+            setattr(metadata, full_attr, None)
+
+        self._init_swa_scheduler_metadata(
+            metadata,
+            swa_attr,
+            max_seqlen_k=k_len,
+            cache_seqlens=k_len_tensor,
+            cu_seqlens_q=cu_seqlens_q,
+            cu_seqlens_k_new=cu_seqlens_k_new,
+            max_seqlen_q=q_len,
+            causal=True,
+            page_size=self.page_size,
+        )
+
+    def _init_cp_local_scheduler_metadata(
+        self,
+        metadata: MusaFlashAttentionMetadata,
+        local_metadata: Optional[MusaLocalAttentionMetadata],
+        side: str,
+        *,
+        q_len: int,
+        k_len: int,
+        k_len_tensor: torch.Tensor,
+        cu_seqlens_q: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> None:
+        local_attr = f"cp_local_scheduler_metadata_{side}"
+        local_swa_attr = f"cp_local_swa_scheduler_metadata_{side}"
+        # Local attention has separate block tables. Its scheduler metadata uses
+        # the same CP q/cache lengths, but no `cu_seqlens_k_new` because the local
+        # path does not append newly gathered KV through the normal paged-cache
+        # table in the callback.
+        if local_metadata is not None and self._attention_layouts.has_local_attention:
+            setattr(
+                metadata,
+                local_attr,
+                self._build_scheduler_metadata(
+                    max_seqlen_k=k_len,
+                    cache_seqlens=k_len_tensor,
+                    cu_seqlens_q=cu_seqlens_q,
+                    cu_seqlens_k_new=None,
+                    max_seqlen_q=q_len,
+                    causal=True,
+                    window_size=(-1, -1),
+                    page_size=self.page_size,
+                ),
+            )
+        else:
+            setattr(metadata, local_attr, None)
+
+        if (
+            local_metadata is not None
+            and self._attention_layouts.has_sliding_window_local_attention
+        ):
+            self._init_swa_scheduler_metadata(

This attribute list is hand-maintained, so any metadata field added later (another CP variant, another local-attention tensor) silently escapes replay refresh. The only thing that catches the drift is the slot-set `assert` in `_copy_fresh_metadata_to_graph_tensors()` — which `-O` strips.

Suggest deriving the slot set from `dataclasses.fields()` on the metadata classes, or defining one canonical name list that both `_clear_cp_scheduler_metadata()` (`:792`) and this function consume, so add/clear/refresh cannot drift apart.

inline_comments.body:
Two problems with the Gemma4 split policy:

1. The comments contradict each other. `:219-222` says Gemma4 SWA is faster *without* split-KV; this comment says auto (`num_splits=0`) is faster at `bs < 8` and that split=1 wins above it. One of them is stale.
2. `self.num_splits = 1` (`:223`) silently overrides `--flash-attention-num-splits` for this model, and the numbers quoted here ("7-17 us", "the AIME tail") have no measurement attached, while the PR body states "No performance claim is made".

Either attach the benchmark — per-layer and end-to-end, both `bs` regimes — or drop the tuning and keep the user's flag. The MiniMax-M2 special case (`:415-433`) has the same issue: two model identities hardcoded inside a device backend belongs in a tuning table.

+        full_layouts: set[AttentionLayout] = set()
+        swa_layouts: set[AttentionLayout] = set()
+        swa_window_sizes: set[int] = set()
+        has_full_attention_layer = False
+        has_local_attention_layer = False
+        has_cross_attention_layer = False
+        has_swa_local_attention_layer = False
+        for module in model_runner.model.modules():
+            if not isinstance(module, RadixAttention):
+                continue
+
+            if getattr(module, "is_cross_attention", False):
+                has_cross_attention_layer = True
+                continue
+
+            if (
+                module.sliding_window_size is not None
+                and module.sliding_window_size > -1
+            ):
+                swa_layouts.add(cls._layer_attention_layout(module))
+                swa_window_sizes.add(module.sliding_window_size)
+                has_swa_local_attention_layer |= bool(
+                    getattr(module, "use_irope", False)
+                )
+            else:
+                full_layouts.add(cls._layer_attention_layout(module))
+                has_full_attention_layer = True
+
+            has_local_attention_layer |= bool(getattr(module, "use_irope", False))
+
+        full_layouts = sorted(full_layouts)
+        swa_layouts = sorted(swa_layouts)
+        if len(full_layouts) > 1 or len(swa_layouts) > 1:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "MUSA FA3 no-MLA scheduler metadata assumes one uniform "
+                "self-attention layout for all full-attention layers and one "
+                "uniform self-attention layout for all SWA layers; full and "
+                f"SWA layouts may differ. Got full={full_layouts} "
+                f"and swa={swa_layouts}."
+            )
+
+        swa_window_sizes = sorted(swa_window_sizes)
+        if len(swa_window_sizes) > 1:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "MUSA FA3 no-MLA scheduler metadata assumes one uniform SWA "
+                f"window size. Got {swa_window_sizes}."
+            )
+
+        full_layout = full_layouts[0] if full_layouts else None
+        swa_layout = swa_layouts[0] if swa_layouts else full_layout
+        full_layout = full_layout if full_layout is not None else swa_layout
+        swa_window_size = (
+            (swa_window_sizes[0], 0) if len(swa_window_sizes) == 1 else None
+        )
+        return MusaAttentionLayouts(
+            full=full_layout,
+            sliding_window=swa_layout,
+            sliding_window_size=swa_window_size,
+            has_full_attention=has_full_attention_layer,
+            has_local_attention=has_local_attention_layer,
+            has_cross_attention=has_cross_attention_layer,
+            has_sliding_window_local_attention=has_swa_local_attention_layer,
+        )
+
+    def _needs_no_mla_kvcache_scheduler_metadata(
+        self,
+        forward_batch: SchedulerMetadataBatch,
+        *,
+        is_cross_attention: bool = False,
+    ) -> bool:
+        forward_mode = forward_batch.forward_mode
+        extend_prefix_lens_cpu = getattr(forward_batch, "extend_prefix_lens_cpu", None)
+        extend_with_prefix = extend_prefix_lens_cpu is not None and any(
+            extend_prefix_lens_cpu
+        )
+        return is_cross_attention or (
+            forward_mode.is_decode_or_idle()
+            or forward_mode.is_target_verify()
+            or forward_mode.is_draft_extend_v2()
+            or (
+                forward_mode.is_extend_or_draft_extend_or_mixed(
+                    include_draft_extend_v2=True
+                )
+                and extend_with_prefix
+            )
+        )
+
+    def _num_splits_for_no_mla_full_kvcache(
+        self, forward_batch: SchedulerMetadataBatch
+    ) -> int:
+        """Keep MiniMax-M2 decode-like full-attention metadata/calls aligned."""
+        if not self._is_minimax_m2:
+            return self.full_attention_num_splits
+
+        batch_size = getattr(forward_batch, "batch_size", None)
+        if batch_size is None or batch_size > MINIMAX_M2_DECODE_SPLIT_MAX_BS:
+            return self.num_splits
+
+        forward_mode = forward_batch.forward_mode
+        if (
+            forward_mode.is_decode_or_idle()
+            or forward_mode.is_target_verify()
+            or forward_mode.is_draft_extend_v2()
+        ):
+            return MINIMAX_M2_DECODE_NUM_SPLITS
+        return self.num_splits
+

+        # On Gemma4/S5000, forcing one split only wins at the largest captured
+        # decode batch. FA3 auto scheduling is 7-17 us faster per SWA layer at
